root_cause: The JSON flag reached GPTConfig, but GPT.configure_optimizers omitted hierarchical_feedback_fit from the actual MuonPairVQ constructor. An earlier edit mistakenly supplied it to a generic Muon branch that is inactive when every MLP matrix is Pair-VQ. Thus the model_config log showed true while the optimizer still used its default false value.

changes: Remove the invalid keyword from the generic Muon branch.
Pass the flag to the MuonPairVQ constructor.
Add a mocked constructor-level regression test.
Emit pair_vq_optimizer_config at startup so the exact log proves the active optimizer flag.

next_gate: Repeat the exact H100 preflight and require both model_config true and pair_vq_optimizer_config hierarchical_feedback_fit=[true] before applying any state or performance threshold.
